items.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I used to think that — imagine being a piano player with like Billie Holiday and making this judgement well do I go with her? Do I play where she’s at or do I just like straight ahead? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Well the first thing, the answer to the first part of the question, of course I recognize that that certain drummers sound great with certain bass players. There’s a marriage made in heaven with some, and then there’s ones that might be great players with other drummers or bass players but they don’t seem to play together great. So without saying names, you know, so for me my role is to be flexible. I need to like be able to play with this type of rhythm section, with that type of rhythm section. So I always…
